name: Toast station lens pane reads Fixed with lens

planSteps.description: Take the address of the page already open, keep everything before '#' exactly as it is, and open it with '#/letter/toast' after it (for example .../#/letter/toast). Do not go to any other site address. Wait 3 seconds
Verify the state line ends with 'Misread.'
Click the 'Lens' button in the pane switch
Verify the 'Lens' button is pressed, the state line now ends with 'Fixed with lens.', and the URL contains 'pane=lens'
